env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd mainlgo
logos build -o $WORK/app$GOEXE .
! stderr 'capabilities::'
cp ../missing_table.toml logos.toml
logos build -o $WORK/app$GOEXE .
! stderr 'capabilities::'
cp ../missing_key.toml logos.toml
logos build -o $WORK/app$GOEXE .
! stderr 'capabilities::'
cp ../deny.toml logos.toml
! logos build -o $WORK/app$GOEXE .
stderr 'capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe'
stderr 'capabilities::unclassified_assembly'
cd ..

cd maingo
logos build -o $WORK/app$GOEXE .
! stderr 'capabilities::'
cp ../missing_table.toml logos.toml
logos build -o $WORK/app$GOEXE .
! stderr 'capabilities::'
cp ../missing_key.toml logos.toml
logos build -o $WORK/app$GOEXE .
! stderr 'capabilities::'
cp ../deny.toml logos.toml
! logos build -o $WORK/app$GOEXE .
stderr 'capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe'
stderr 'capabilities::unclassified_assembly'
cd ..

-- missing_table.toml --
[build]
opt_level = "O2"
-- missing_key.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_net = "warn"
-- deny.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_unsafe = "deny"
-- mainlgo/go.mod --
module example.com/main

go 1.27

require example.com/dep v0.0.0
replace example.com/dep => ../dep
-- mainlgo/main.lgo --
package main
import _ "example.com/dep"
func main() {}
-- maingo/go.mod --
module example.com/main

go 1.27

require example.com/dep v0.0.0
replace example.com/dep => ../dep
-- maingo/main.go --
package main
import _ "example.com/dep"
func main() {}
-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/dep

go 1.27
-- dep/dep.go --
package dep
import "unsafe"
var _ = unsafe.Sizeof(0)
-- dep/empty.s --
